name: Chatlivo – Live Chat, WhatsApp Chat & AI Chatbot
author: chatlivo

sections.description:
Chatlivo adds live chat, WhatsApp chat, an AI chatbot and no-code chatbot flows to your WordPress site in one click. Talk to visitors in real time, capture leads, and manage website chats and WhatsApp messages from one shared inbox. Free to start, no credit card required.

Live chat, WhatsApp and AI chatbot in one plugin

  • Live chat – chat with visitors in real time, on desktop and mobile.
  • WhatsApp chat – WhatsApp Business integration included on the free plan; WhatsApp and website chats land in the same inbox.
  • AI chatbot – answers common questions 24/7, trained on your own business content.
  • Chatbot flows – no-code flows that collect name and email before handing off to a live agent.
  • Visitor tracking – see who is on your site, which pages they view and where they came from.
  • Pre-chat forms and offline messages – capture leads even when your team is away.
  • Shared team inbox – assign conversations and track open, pending and resolved chats.
  • Custom branding – colors, position, welcome message and launcher icon.
  • Mobile apps – reply from the Chatlivo iOS and Android apps.
  • Multilingual – the Chatlivo dashboard is available in multiple languages.

Why Chatlivo?

  • Live in 30 seconds – install, activate, connect your free account. No code.
  • Free plan with WhatsApp – most live chat plugins charge extra for it.
  • Lightweight – loads asynchronously, under 20KB, no iframe.
  • Privacy-minded – encrypted data transmission and GDPR best practices.
  • Works with any theme, including WooCommerce stores.

Pricing

  • Free: 1 agent, 25 conversations/month, live chat + WhatsApp, 14-day history.
  • Pro: $12/month ($10/month billed annually) – unlimited agents and conversations.
  • Business: $24/month ($20/month billed annually) – white-label and advanced analytics.

Great for

WooCommerce and ecommerce stores, SaaS, healthcare, education, real estate, travel, law firms, insurance, agencies and service businesses.

External services

This plugin connects your site to the Chatlivo service (chatlivo.com) to load the chat and sync conversations. A free Chatlivo account is required.

  • Chatlivo API (https://api.chatlivo.com) – used to sign up, log in and verify your email (OTP), register your site and fetch the chat widget script. Data sent: the email address, name and password you enter, the OTP code, and your site URL/domain. This happens only when you use the Chatlivo screens in the WordPress admin.
  • Chatlivo widget (https://widget.chatlivo.com) – the chat widget script loaded on your site’s front end once the chat is active. It processes visitor chat messages and visitor details (such as pages viewed, referrer and the name/email visitors choose to provide) so you can reply from your Chatlivo inbox.

The service is provided by Chatlivo: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy | Data Processing Agreement
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chatlivo-live-chat-ai-chatbot folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. You’ll be taken to the Chatlivo setup screen.
  3. Create a free account (verify the OTP emailed to you) or log in.
  4. The chat widget script is added to your site’s head automatically.
sections.faq:
Is there a free live chat plugin for WordPress with WhatsApp?

Yes. Chatlivo’s free plan includes live chat and WhatsApp Business integration, with 1 agent and 25 conversations per month. No credit card needed.

How do I add WhatsApp chat to my WordPress site?

Install and activate Chatlivo, connect your free account, then link WhatsApp from the Channels page in your Chatlivo dashboard. WhatsApp and website chats arrive in one inbox.

Does Chatlivo have an AI chatbot for WordPress?

Yes. You can train the AI chatbot on your own business content so it answers common questions 24/7, then hand off to a live agent when needed.

Can I build chatbot flows without coding?

Yes. Chatbot flows are no-code. For example, a flow can collect a visitor’s name and email before passing them to an agent.

Do I need a Chatlivo account?

Yes. After activation, create a free account (verify the email OTP) or log in. The chat is added to your site automatically.

Will Chatlivo slow down my website?

No. The script loads asynchronously, is under 20KB and doesn’t use an iframe.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Chatlivo loads site-wide and works with any theme, including WooCommerce stores.

Can I see who is on my website right now?

Yes. Visitor tracking shows live visitors, current pages, referral sources and browsing history.

Is there a mobile app?

Yes. Chatlivo is available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play), and the dashboard works in any mobile browser.

Can I use one account on multiple websites?

One account supports one website. A guided transfer screen lets you move it to another site.

Is Chatlivo GDPR compliant?

Chatlivo uses encrypted data transmission and secure infrastructure designed with GDPR best practices.

Which languages does Chatlivo support?

Chatlivo is multilingual. The dashboard is available in multiple languages, so your team can work in the language they prefer.

Can multiple team members reply?

Yes. Pro and Business plans include unlimited agents, with chat assignment and a shared inbox. The free plan includes 1 agent.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Updated plugin name, description and readme.
  • Added external services disclosure, FAQ and mobile app links.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Sign up or log in to Chatlivo from the WordPress dashboard, with email OTP verification.
  • One-click connection: the widget script is fetched from the Chatlivo API and added to the site’s head (async).
  • Domain-aware: one Chatlivo account supports one website, with a guided transfer screen when the account is connected to another site.
  • Activate/deactivate the chat, single sign-on links into the Chatlivo dashboard, and full cleanup on uninstall.
  • Session token stored encrypted at rest.
